name: Zaply.me
author: zaplyme

sections.description:
Zaply.me for WooCommerce connects a WooCommerce store to a Zaply.me account. It registers completed orders with Zaply.me, sends delayed video-review invitations from the store, and sends reward emails with coupons after a video is approved.

A Zaply.me account and company slug are required. Invitation and reward emails are sent by WooCommerce using the store’s configured mail transport.

External services

Zaply.me API

This plugin connects to the Zaply.me API (https://api.zaply.me) to register the store and eligible completed orders, and to receive reward notifications after video approval. The store slug and store URL are sent when the integration is registered. The order ID and customer’s billing first name (or billing last name if unavailable) are sent when an eligible order is registered. The API returns a token used to create the customer’s review link. Customer email addresses are not sent to the API by this plugin; review and reward emails are sent by the store’s WooCommerce mailer and can be disabled individually in WooCommerce email settings.

Requests to the production API use HTTPS. The service is provided by Zaply.me and requires a Zaply.me account. See the Zaply.me Terms and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/zaply-me-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Settings → Zaply.me and enter the company slug from your Zaply.me account.
  4. Configure the store’s review terms URL in Zaply.me. Review invitations are not sent unless Zaply.me confirms that the terms URL is configured.
  5. Configure the invitation delay and coupon settings.
sections.faq:
What information is sent to Zaply.me?

When the store is connected, the plugin sends the company slug and store URL. When an eligible order is completed, it sends the order ID and the customer’s billing first name (or billing last name if the first name is unavailable) to identify the order and prepare its review invitation. The customer’s email address is not sent to the Zaply.me API by this plugin.

Where are customer emails sent from?

Review invitations and reward emails are sent by WooCommerce through the store’s configured mail transport.
